chapters.label: The winner, live
chapters.text: Goodison Park, November 2025. Everton and Manchester City are level at one-all. Leila Ouahabi swings in a cross... Bunny Shaw rises above her defender and heads it home!

chapters.label: Beside her defender
chapters.text: Watch it again. Bunny waits for the cross beside her defender, then springs up, higher than Rion Ishikawa.

chapters.label: Crash it home
chapters.text: Her forehead crashes it past the keeper. Two-one! Manchester City go top of the league.

chapters.label: The secret
chapters.text: The secret? Use your body to hold off the defender. Then attack the ball with your forehead, eyes open, and head it with power.
